name: iFizBox
subtitle: A package manager with the iOS 6 look
description: iFizBox's own source: the iFizBox app for iPhones without a jailbreak.

apps.name: iFizBox
apps.subtitle: Packages and apps with the iOS 6 look
apps.localizedDescription: iFizBox lists apps from AltStore-style sources and, on a jailbroken iPhone, tweaks and themes from APT repos, with the iOS 6 look. The app signs apps on your iPhone with your own certificate (no server) and scrolls at 120Hz. Free and open source (GPL-3.0-or-later).

versions.localizedDescription:
Version 0.9.7
Search: one character searches too
R20: archive ticked tasks
R20: convert Teehan+Lax iOS 7/8 kits into ref/teehanlax/ios7, ios8; journal lists their controls, the iOS 8 vs 7 differences and what the sketch .ai is
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.9.7

Version 0.9.6
F204: archive ticked tasks
F204 Top notices stop moving the page: banner under the nav bar (5s/8s timer line, pause on touch, tap/swipe up), reload bar on top of the tab bar, scrollers get 44pt room; no has-banner/has-reload push
B41 App page: Related tab icons fill their tile over the letter fallback; header icon and Share inset 21px like the grouped rows
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.9.6

Version 0.9.5
App: turn off shake to undo (accidental Undo Typing alerts)
Search: iOS 6 Cancel button right of the field, clears it and hides the keyboard
F178 iFizBox's AltStore source at https://ifizbox.com/repo/source.json (Worker /repo route, release asset fallback) and lite/full kept apart: the jailbreak app hides the lite IPA, the sideload app offers no .deb or APT repo
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.9.5

Website installs bring your certificate and settings into iFizBox again, under the new com.ryha.ifizbox ID.
Installs end on Done once iOS has the install link; no more page stuck at 72%.
Settings > General: Return to Home After. Home's Recommended Sources opens the new Recommended page, with Add All.
The install log starts on the real first step (no Signing, Reading, Signing).
Release notes: https://github.com/RyanAHayden/iFizBox/releases/tag/v0.9.4
